meta.title: Discuss / Execute Split
meta.description: Discussion stays read-only, and every repository code edit goes to Codex. The discussion runs on the DSH model or through the Claude Code CLI.

form.title: Discussion mode
form.apiRequirement: Requires an Anthropic provider and API key
form.unavailable: Configuration is unavailable. Enable this plugin and the Settings service.
form.failed: Save failed. Check the configuration and try again.
form.blocked: Preflight failed. The current mode is unchanged.
form.apiReady: API checks passed. Select it, then click “Check and save” to switch.
form.cliReady: Claude Code CLI checks passed. Select it, then click “Check and save” to switch.
form.bothNeedFix: Neither mode passes its checks. Fix either mode using the hints below.
form.modelsHint: To change the base URL, key or models, open Settings → Models.
form.connectionMissing: Configured models absent from the list: {models}
form.connectionUnsupported: This address cannot list models, so this check is inconclusive; it does not mean the key is invalid.
form.connectionTimeout: Connection timed out. Check the base URL, network or proxy.
form.connectionUnreachable: Cannot connect. Check the base URL, network or proxy.
form.connectionRedirect: The address redirected; the key was not forwarded. Check the base URL.
form.connectionHttp: Connection failed (HTTP {status}). Check the base URL, network or proxy.
form.connectionNoKey: No key configured. Open Settings → Models to configure it.
